detail: Q? ("Polar bears have thick fur and a layer of fat under their skin to stay warm in freezing Arctic temperatures. What is this feature called?") assigned Age 9 High Achiever but reads as single-fact recall ("what is X called" / "what do we call") rather than multi-step reasoning — High Achiever should mean the child has to compare, predict, or trace a chain, not just name a term. Consider moving to a plain age band.
